name: Narain Soothfancy
summary: Along Tanaris’s eastern shore, Narain Soothfancy offers visitors his visions. The gnome lives in a secluded hut just north of Steamwheedle Port, though those who know him value his engineering more than his prophecies.

sections.title: Psychic Visions and Practical Gearing
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy, a retired engineer, lives on Tanaris’s eastern coast just north of the goblin docks. He greets visitors with unopened envelopes pressed to his forehead or guesses at their business. Sometimes he asks if they seek the legendary Ashbringer. His fortune-telling is a show, but his technical knowledge is real. Even the blue dragon Azuregos calls Narain a poor psychic and a brilliant engineer. Nearby rests a handbook titled Soothsaying for Dummies.

sections.title: A Shoreline Crash
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy survived a flying machine crash far south along Land’s End Beach before settling near Steamwheedle Port. An unexpected rescue saved him from the wreck. His eccentric nature and strange obsessions have kept him isolated on the desert shore. There he tinkers with arcane-adjacent technology and offers dubious prophecies to passersby.

faq.answer: Narain Soothfancy is a retired gnome engineer living in Tanaris, north of Steamwheedle Port. He advertises himself as a master soothsayer, though his predictions are famously inaccurate.
No. The blue dragon Azuregos calls Narain a poor psychic. Narain’s true gift is engineering, despite his theatrical attempts at mind-reading.

faq.q: What is the book 'Soothsaying for Dummies' beside him?
faq.answer: Soothsaying for Dummies is a handbook kept in Narain’s hut and associated with specialized trades. Narain directs travelers seeking such knowledge to the book.
Narain Soothfancy is an old associate of the blue dragon Azuregos, who wanders Azshara. Azuregos respects Narain’s engineering and crafting skill despite his bizarre pretensions.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may find Narain’s wild inventions fascinating, though he claims his mechanical achievements come from mystical visions.
As a gnome, you may recognize Narain’s eccentric blend of brilliant engineering and bizarre, obsessive hobbies.
